material.acceptance_criteria: The sim exposes a public fire_trigger(unit, trigger) that returns a typed refusal for an unknown trigger or a unit without the behaviour, and the mechanic gate check calls it.
material.description: rust/crates/sim/src/triggers.rs:17 fire_triggers, :40 note_idle and :54 run_behaviours are pub(crate) or private, and no pub fn in the sim exposes firing a trigger. The mechanic-trigger gate check therefore exercises the behaviour trigger indirectly rather than through a public API, which the mod-host and scripts cannot call either.
material.resolution: verifier gm-orch-2-11-v1 at e03ee19: fire_trigger (triggers.rs:95-117) returns false on out-of-range unit or unknown trigger; gate mechanic-trigger-firing and behaviour-trigger-fires PASS (live gate run, dispatch 1792269051957-500-23897c57ba8a642d). CI green on tip.
material.subject: The sim has no public API to fire a named behaviour trigger on a unit

material.witness_plan: Gate check in rust/gate/src/mechanic_checks.rs calls the public fire_trigger and asserts the expected action effect and the refusal case, run in CI.
